reference: Eisenhauer EA, et al. Eur J Cancer. 2009;45(2):228-247

responses.name: Complete Response
responses.definition: Disappearance of all target lesions. Any pathological lymph nodes must have reduction in short axis to <10 mm.

responses.name: Partial Response
responses.definition: At least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions, taking as reference the baseline sum diameters.

responses.name: Stable Disease
responses.definition: Neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for PD, taking as reference the smallest sum diameters while on study.

responses.name: Progressive Disease
responses.definition: At least a 20% increase in the sum of diameters of target lesions, taking as reference the smallest sum on study (includes baseline). In addition, the sum must demonstrate an absolute increase of at least 5 mm. Appearance of one or more new lesions is also considered progression.

responses.name: Not Evaluable
responses.definition: Assessment cannot be made due to missing measurements, poor image quality, or other technical reasons.

non_target_lesion_responses.name: Complete Response
non_target_lesion_responses.definition: Disappearance of all non-target lesions and normalization of tumor marker levels. All lymph nodes must be non-pathological in size (<10 mm short axis).

non_target_lesion_responses.name: Non-CR/Non-PD
non_target_lesion_responses.definition: Persistence of one or more non-target lesion(s) and/or maintenance of tumor marker level above the normal limits.

non_target_lesion_responses.name: Progressive Disease
non_target_lesion_responses.definition: Unequivocal progression of existing non-target lesions. The overall level of substantial worsening in non-target disease must be representative of change in disease burden even in the presence of SD or PR in target disease.

clinical_measurement.notes: Must be superficial and measured with calipers

overall_response_matrix.description: Overall response based on combination of target and non-target lesion responses

responder.description: Patient showing tumor shrinkage on treatment

stable.description: Patient with disease control but minimal shrinkage

pseudoprogression.description: Initial apparent progression followed by response (common with immunotherapy)

mixed_response.description: Some lesions shrink while others grow

irrecist_modifications.description: Immune-related RECIST (iRECIST) modifications for immunotherapy trials
irrecist_modifications.reference: Seymour L, et al. Lancet Oncol. 2017;18(3):e143-e152

additional_responses.name: Immune Unconfirmed Progressive Disease
additional_responses.definition: First occurrence of PD criteria. Requires confirmation at next assessment (4-8 weeks).

additional_responses.name: Immune Confirmed Progressive Disease
additional_responses.definition: Confirmed progressive disease on subsequent assessment after iUPD.

key_differences: New lesions do not automatically define PD; they are incorporated into total tumor burden
Progression must be confirmed at next assessment (iUPD -> iCPD)
Treatment may continue beyond initial progression pending confirmation
